noXrtLoadedMessage: To load an XRT into the editor you can navigate to the page or panel from the primary tab or manually use the above load options. This editor is linked to the primary tab from where you opened the Editor. The editor will follow your navigations in the primary tab, displaying the style sheet used to render each applicable page or panel. Alternatively, if you already know what to load, use the above drop-down menus and the "Load" button to display the XRT.
